title: 顶层列表与明确结束标记
guidance: For a page-number GET response with items, has_next and total: inspect /items, /has_next and /total. Map each requested field relative to an actual item. Use only query parameters present in the observed request. Verify total and unique identifiers across pages.

title: 嵌套记录列表
guidance: For nested data.records, candidate pointers are /data/records, /data/totalCount and /data/hasMore only if these paths exist in the observation. Field pointers are relative to one record, not the response root. Do not infer absent stop flags.

title: 别名字段映射
guidance: A rows array may use sku and title where the requested outputs are id and name. Confirm observed types and meaning before mapping. The page parameter may be p. Use /more or /total only when present. Never copy an example request identifier.

title: 只有总数的分页
guidance: An item count and a page count are different. total_pointer must refer to the total number of records, never totalPages. With no boolean continuation flag, set has_next_pointer to null. Respect the page limit and report partial results when completeness is unknown.

title: 游标分页边界
guidance: Cursor pagination is unsupported by the current page-number executor. Do not disguise a cursor as a numeric page parameter or invent a compatible request. The local validator must reject an incompatible plan.

title: 偏移量分页边界
guidance: Offset pagination increments by a batch size and is unsupported by the current executor, which starts at page 1 and increments by 1. Do not label offset as a page number. Prefer a genuinely observed page-number request if available.
